observation_summary: An IllegalStateException is thrown with the message 'Recorded bad position information' during JSDoc parsing.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the JSDoc parser fails to reset its internal state ('unreadToken') after consuming a line of JSDoc content. When the parser encounters specific JSDoc structures, the stale token state causes the parser to miscalculate the character positions of the text, leading to an IllegalStateException when the recorded end position is less than the start position. The fix involves explicitly resetting the 'unreadToken' state to 'NO_UNREAD_TOKEN' within the 'getRemainingJSDocLine' method, ensuring that subsequent parsing operations start from a clean state.
